sloka: वनानि गिरयः चैव विक्रोशंति इव सर्वतः ।पुलिने गिरि नद्याः तु विविक्ते जल संवृते ॥४-२५-३७॥
transliteration: vanāni girayaḥ caiva vikrośaṁti iva sarvataḥ ।puline giri nadyāḥ tu vivikte jala saṁvṛte ॥4-25-37॥

translations.english: Putting down the palanquin from their shoulders on the lonely spot, the bearers stood in tearswaiting.
